family_allocation.rule: allocate distinct primary physical positions in ranking order; do not duplicate a primary within the same target event
family_allocation.fallback_rule: next distinct ranked physical positions, frozen with the primary before outcome

current_recalculation.rule: after every newly incorporated real roulette, recompute all unresolved future events using the same model policy and the new canonical cutoff

freeze.weekly: after both 04/10/2026 election-Sunday real roulettes are incorporated and validated, after 20:00 America/Sao_Paulo
freeze.current: before operational position selection for each target event

random_shadow.rule: generate a deterministic ranked candidate chain before outcome; resolve to first eligible position once occupied positions are known
